resources.bodyExcerpt: WordPress is a massive project with dozens of teams, each with their own handbooks, tools, and processes. There are hundreds of ways to contribute, but for someone new, it can be hard to know where to begin. Pathway guides pull together the basic steps and connections folks need to start contributing quickly, while linking out to deeper context in handbooks.
